```{=html}
<style>
  .pkg-desc-text {
    font-size: 0.95em; 
    font-family: 'Georgia', serif; 
    max-width: 900px;
    color: #777777; /* 纯正的深灰色，用于默认亮色主题 */
  }
  body.quarto-dark .pkg-desc-text,
  html[data-bs-theme="dark"] .pkg-desc-text {
    color: #cccccc; /* 提亮的浅灰色，用于暗黑主题 */
  }

  /* --- Active 专属交互式分割线 --- */
  #interactive-divider {
    position: relative;
    max-height: 2px; /* 初始状态表现为一条线 */
    background-color: var(--bs-border-color); /* 融入系统的边框颜色 */
    margin: 15px 0 35px 0; /* 留出合适的上下间距 */
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.6s ease, background-color 0.4s ease, padding 0.4s ease;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
  }

  /* 扩大不可见的鼠标触发区域，方便触发 hover */
  #interactive-divider::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -15px;
    bottom: -15px;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  #interactive-divider:hover {
    max-height: 500px; /* 展开后足够容纳文字的高度 */
    background-color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.05); /* 轻微的高亮背景 */
    padding: 20px 30px;
    border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color); /* 展开后显现一个淡淡的边框 */
    cursor: auto;
  }

  #interactive-divider .pkg-desc-text {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2; /* 确保文字在伪元素之上，防止被遮挡无法选中文字 */
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(10px);
    transition: opacity 0.4s ease 0.2s, transform 0.4s ease 0.2s; /* 延迟出现 */
  }

  #interactive-divider:hover .pkg-desc-text {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  const moveDivider = () => {
    const placeholder = document.getElementById('interactive-divider-placeholder');
    const divider = document.getElementById('interactive-divider');
    // 将隐藏的描述特效块精确移动到 EJS 模板预留的插槽中
    if (placeholder && divider && placeholder.children.length === 0) {
      placeholder.appendChild(divider);
    }
  };
  
  moveDivider();
  // 额外的延迟调用，防止 Quarto 渲染结构较慢
  setTimeout(moveDivider, 150);
  setTimeout(moveDivider, 500);
});
</script>
```

## Active

::: {#list-active}
:::

::: {#interactive-divider}
::: {.pkg-desc-text}

  It is not just from binary to multi, but a universal platform for constructing RL models.

  - **Latent Rule Learning**  
    Supports learning latent rules (cues != responses).

  - **Multiple Cognitive Systems**  
    Supports parallel updating of multiple Q-tables ($Q_{RL}$, $Q_{WM}$, $Q_{..}$).

  - **Flexible Trial-by-Trial Model Construction**  
    Supports infinite parameters and variables.

  - **Multiple Parameter Estimation Methods**  
    Supports MLE, MAP, ABC, and RNN-based estimation approaches.

:::
:::

## Archived

::: {.pkg-desc-text}
These packages were developed to manage and analyze the large datasets involved in the <a href="projects/2025_ReliabilitySMT.html"><i>Reliability of the Self‑Matching Task</i></a> project. By packaging core functions, they avoid the messiness of traditional procedural scripts, facilitating both smooth project progression and reproducible research.
:::
